recordBonus.trustedRootsAre: treasury v4 only. Not the seat vaults: an owner can seat its own agent with its own $PRIORS and get the fees back, so their fees are not someone else's risk.
recordBonus.scale: a step is 0.02 USDG of sponsor fees paid under the treasury: at the live pool (1% per 30 days, 25% to the sponsor) about 240 dollar-days of treasury credit repaid. +1 point per step on a 50% stock, scaled down with the stock's own loan-to-value (a 25% stock gets half), at most +15 on a 50% stock (about 3,600 dollar-days, e.g. a $25 treasury line drawn for 144 days). Never above 70% in total. Retune with the pool's fee params.
